text:
Kirby Dach was traded on Monday. The Red Wings sent Dylan Larkin to Montreal for a package that included Dach, Michael Hage, Samuel Montembeault and first-round picks, as NHL.com's Tom Gulitti reported. Dach had been playing well before it: The Athletic's Arpon Basu noted an impressive streak, and Habs Eyes on the Prize wrote that he was finding his form. One Montreal podcast had even said he was building his trade value.

His Montreal numbers at the time of the deal were modest but steady: eight points in 22 games in under 12 minutes a night, about even on five-on-five expected goals (which measure the quality of chances). The third overall pick of 2019 has fought injuries for much of his career, and Detroit gets a 25-year-old center with size and a chance at a bigger role on a team rebuilding around the space Larkin left. Our range had him around 32 points. Watch his minutes in his first games as a Red Wing.
